shots.excerpt: She stops and smiles sweetly into the lens. A thin dark vein cracks under her left eye. Both eyes turn solid milky-white, the smile freezes.
shots.voice: Shot 1. A sweet close-up, then one vein cracks under her eye and both eyes turn milky-white.

shots.excerpt: A wide, bloody grin. Her head tilts to an unnatural, almost horizontal angle, then snaps back, laughing hysterically, while the guard keeps smiling, unaware.
shots.voice: Unnatural angle is the key phrase. Her head bends too far, and the guard behind her keeps smiling.

shots.excerpt: Wide shot from behind, handheld with hard shake. She spins and slams the guard back against the cell bars with a metal clang.
highlight: slams the guard back against the cell bars
shots.voice: Shot 2. The camera switches to rough handheld shake, so the attack feels real and sudden.

shots.excerpt: Low, floor-level tracking shot from behind. She is on all fours like an animal, knees high, and scuttles fast down the corridor.
highlight: on all fours like an animal
shots.voice: Shot 3. A floor-level tracking shot keeps the camera at her height as she scuttles away like an animal.

shots.excerpt: Symmetrical one-point wide, light strobing red and white. She crawls upside down across the ceiling like a spider while prisoners scream at the bars.
shots.voice: Shot 5. A symmetrical wide with strobing red light, and she is crawling upside down across the ceiling.

shots.excerpt: Locked-off, total black frame. Two small glowing milky-white eyes. A blood-covered hand presses flat against the glass, fingers spread.
shots.voice: Shot 6. A total black frame, two glowing eyes, then a bloody hand on the glass. That is the ending.
